scope: Historical locations for offline porting; never automatic authorization to write on another build.

native_slot.cursor_semantics: Allocation probe cursor, not a shot counter; uint32 modular delta, slot mask 0x7ff. Occupied-slot probes may also increment it.

required_checks: Both disk hashes and PE virtual sections covering every used RVA
All 15 anchors (12 base plus 3 cursor); a short runtime anchor is not a safe offline locator
P-11 dedicated identity, avatar and stim definition; broad scope classification, local owner, active weapon and attachment owner
Fresh reads every update, per-write dependency revalidation, original flags and readback
MEM_PRIVATE PAGE_READWRITE only; clear only runtime bit 0x20 with a two-byte write
User-reported basic behavior and offline/mock evidence do not prove all weapons, host/client, timing, or performance
self_hit.porting_note: Version a new runtime for an actual port. Preserve the accepted preview.8 four Lua/resource byte sequences and historical successful packages. Updating a profile/hash alone is insufficient.

cursor_limits.note: Keep only bounded slot hints across updates, never cached identity/write authorization. Deferred hints go first, P-11 candidates write first. Drops/expiry can miss projectiles; counters are not shot/hit counts. Preserve budgets and all guards.

weapon_candidates.projectile_filter: maintenance/projectile-exclusions-25480438.json; pinned offline table, not current gameplay proof
secondary_mechanism_gaps: The compiled resource lookup covers native-slot candidates only; a complete reference loadout catalog does not prove complete gameplay support or current-build correspondence.
Dagger beam and Crisper spray require their own evidenced ownership, collision-exclusion and timing model; the existing native-slot writer does not implement these mechanisms.
Warrant, P33 and the internal Hornet resource use projectile entities; downstream native slot production and collision timing remain unverified.
Base projectile type zero must be resolved through weapon customizations before claiming the fired type. Actual slot types still pass the existing shotgun/multishot filter.
The captured installed tables have unrecognized/packed headers; pinned plaintext reference inputs cannot be silently treated as those installed files.
